# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/aira-dojo
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/aira-dojo

## File: facebookresearch_aira-dojo/src/dojo/solvers/evo/evo.py

Prompts

```
['run the Evolutionary solver to search for optimal code solutions using LLM-based draft, improve, debug, and crossover operators', 'create an Island to manage a population of solution nodes with fitness tracking and migration support', 'manage a SolutionsDatabase with multiple islands for weighted sampling, migration, and reset of weaker populations', 'run the debug cycle on a buggy node to iteratively fix it using the debug LLM operator', 'sample nodes from the solutions database for in-context learning using weighted island and node selection']
```

Usage

```
{'run_evolutionary_solver': 'run the Evolutionary solver to search for optimal code solutions using LLM-based draft, improve, debug, and crossover operators', 'create_island_population': 'create an Island to manage a population of solution nodes with fitness tracking and migration support', 'manage_solutions_database': 'manage a SolutionsDatabase with multiple islands for weighted sampling, migration, and reset of weaker populations', 'debug_buggy_node': 'run the debug cycle on a buggy node to iteratively fix it using the debug LLM operator', 'sample_in_context': 'sample nodes from the solutions database for in-context learning using weighted island and node selection'}
```
